Elements.Script: local blocksFolder = game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage'):FindFirstChild('LuckyBlocks'); local blockNames = {'All'}; if blocksFolder then for _, v in ipairs(blocksFolder:GetChildren()) do table.insert(blockNames, v.Name) end end; local valid = {}; for _, n in ipairs(blockNames) do valid[n] = true end; getgenv().TargetBlockTypesRaw = {'All'}; getgenv().AutoFarmBlocks = false; local function isPickaxe(t) if not t or not t:IsA('Tool') then return false end; if t.Name:find('Pickaxe') then return true end; for _, v in ipairs(t:GetChildren()) do if v.Name:find('Pickaxe') then return true end end; return false end; local function parseSelection(raw) local selected = {}; local function addName(name) if type(name) == 'string' and valid[name] then selected[name] = true end end; if type(raw) == 'string' then addName(raw) elseif type(raw) == 'table' then for _, name in ipairs(raw) do addName(name) end; for k, v in pairs(raw) do if type(k) == 'string' and valid[k] then if type(v) == 'boolean' then if v then selected[k] = true end elseif type(v) == 'string' then if v == k then selected[k] = true end; addName(v) elseif type(v) == 'number' then if v ~= 0 then selected[k] = true end end end; if type(v) == 'string' then addName(v) end end end; local pickedNonAll = false; for name in pairs(selected) do if name ~= 'All' then pickedNonAll = true; break end end; if pickedNonAll then selected.All = nil end; if next(selected) == nil then selected.All = true end; return selected end; local function collectTargets(folder, selected) local targets = {}; if selected.All then for _, obj in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do if obj:IsA('Model') or obj:IsA('BasePart') then table.insert(targets, obj) end end else for name in pairs(selected) do local target = folder:FindFirstChild(name); if target then table.insert(targets, target) end end end; return targets end; local lp = game.Players.LocalPlayer; local function checkConditions() local char = lp.Character; local root = char and char:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart'); if not root then return end; local zone = workspace:FindFirstChild('InvisWalls') and workspace.InvisWalls:FindFirstChild('DeliveryZone'); if zone and zone:FindFirstChild('TouchInterest') then local hasModel = false; for _, v in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do if v:IsA('Model') then hasModel = true; break end end; if hasModel then firetouchinterest(root, zone, 0); task.wait(); firetouchinterest(root, zone, 1) end end; for _, t in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do if t:IsA('Tool') and not isPickaxe(t) then t.Parent = lp.Backpack end end; if not char:FindFirstChildWhichIsA('Tool') then for _, t in ipairs(lp.Backpack:GetChildren()) do if isPickaxe(t) then t.Parent = char; break end end end; local eq = char:FindFirstChildOfClass('Tool'); if eq and isPickaxe(eq) then eq:Activate() end end; local function collectBrainrots() local container = workspace:FindFirstChild('Brainrots'); local root = lp.Character and lp.Character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart'); if not container or not root then return end; task.wait(0.2); local items = container:GetChildren(); table.sort(items, function(a, b) local ap = a:GetPivot().Position; local bp = b:GetPivot().Position; return (root.Position - ap).Magnitude < (root.Position - bp).Magnitude end); for _, item in ipairs(items) do if not getgenv().AutoFarmBlocks then break end; if item.Parent == container then while getgenv().AutoFarmBlocks and item.Parent == container do root.CFrame = item:GetPivot(); checkConditions(); local prompt = (item:FindFirstChild('Mesh') and item.Mesh:FindFirstChild('PickupPrompt')) or item:FindFirstChild('PickupPrompt', true); if prompt and prompt:IsA('ProximityPrompt') then fireproximityprompt(prompt) end; task.wait(0.05) end end end end; Value:AddDropdown('BlockType', {Title = 'Select Block Type', Values = blockNames, Default = {'All'}, Multi = true, Callback = function(V) getgenv().TargetBlockTypesRaw = V end}); Value:AddToggle('AutoFarmBlocks', {Title = 'Start Auto Farm', Default = false, Callback = function(V) getgenv().AutoFarmBlocks = V; if V then task.spawn(function() local remotes = game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage'):FindFirstChild('Remotes'); local remote = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild('DamageBlockEvent'); while getgenv().AutoFarmBlocks do local folder = workspace:FindFirstChild('LuckyBlocks'); if folder then local selected = parseSelection(getgenv().TargetBlockTypesRaw); local targets = collectTargets(folder, selected); for _, target in ipairs(targets) do if not getgenv().AutoFarmBlocks then break end; while getgenv().AutoFarmBlocks and target.Parent == folder do checkConditions(); local root = lp.Character and lp.Character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart'); if root then root.CFrame = target:GetPivot() end; if remote then remote:FireServer(target) end; task.wait(0.05) end; collectBrainrots() end end; task.wait(0.1) end end) end end})

getgenv().AutoDelivery = false; Value:AddToggle('AutoDelivery', {Title = 'Auto Delivery', Default = false, Callback = function(V) getgenv().AutoDelivery = V; if V then task.spawn(function() local lp = game.Players.LocalPlayer; while getgenv().AutoDelivery do local char = lp.Character; local root = char and char:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart'); local zone = workspace:FindFirstChild('InvisWalls') and workspace.InvisWalls:FindFirstChild('DeliveryZone'); local touch = zone and zone:FindFirstChild('TouchInterest'); if root and touch then local hasModel = false; for _, v in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do if v:IsA('Model') then hasModel = true; break end end; if hasModel then firetouchinterest(root, zone, 0); task.wait(); firetouchinterest(root, zone, 1) end end; task.wait(0.1) end end) end end})

getgenv().AutoCollectAll = false; Value:AddToggle('AutoCollectAll', {Title = 'Auto collect all', Default = false, Callback = function(V) getgenv().AutoCollectAll = V; if V then task.spawn(function() local lp = game.Players.LocalPlayer; local function getMyBase() local bases = workspace:FindFirstChild('Bases'); if not bases then return nil end; for _, base in ipairs(bases:GetChildren()) do local owner = base:GetAttribute('Owner'); if owner and owner == lp.Name then return base end end; return nil end; local function collectFromPlatform(platform, root) local buttonBase = platform:FindFirstChild('ButtonBase'); if not buttonBase or #buttonBase:GetChildren() == 0 then return end; local collect = platform:FindFirstChild('Collect'); if collect then firetouchinterest(root, collect, 0); task.wait(); firetouchinterest(root, collect, 1) end end; while getgenv().AutoCollectAll do local char = lp.Character; local root = char and char:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart'); local myBase = getMyBase(); if root and myBase then for _, floor in ipairs(myBase:GetChildren()) do if floor.Name:match('^Floor%d+$') then local platforms = floor:FindFirstChild('Platforms'); if platforms then for _, platform in ipairs(platforms:GetChildren()) do if not getgenv().AutoCollectAll then break end; collectFromPlatform(platform, root); task.wait(0.05) end end end end end; task.wait(0.25) end end) end end})

getgenv().AutoRebirth = false; Value:AddToggle('AutoRebirth', {Title = 'Auto Rebirth', Default = false, Callback = function(V) getgenv().AutoRebirth = V; if V then task.spawn(function() local remotes = game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage'):FindFirstChild('Remotes'); local rebirth = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild('RebirthEvent'); while getgenv().AutoRebirth do if rebirth then rebirth:FireServer() end; task.wait(1) end end) end end})

local lp = game.Players.LocalPlayer; local remotes = game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage'):FindFirstChild('Remotes'); local equipRemote = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild('EquipPickaxeEvent'); getgenv().SelectedOwnedPickaxe = ''; local function getOwnedPickaxes() local list = {}; local gui = lp:FindFirstChild('PlayerGui') and lp.PlayerGui:FindFirstChild('MainGui'); local frame = gui and gui:FindFirstChild('PickaxesFrame') and gui.PickaxesFrame:FindFirstChild('1'); if not frame then return list end; for _, item in ipairs(frame:GetChildren()) do if item:IsA('ImageButton') and not item.Name:find('Temp') then local equipLabel = item:FindFirstChild('Frame') and item.Frame:FindFirstChild('Equip') and item.Frame.Equip:FindFirstChild('TextLabel'); if equipLabel and (equipLabel.Text == 'Equip' or equipLabel.Text == 'Equipped') then table.insert(list, item.Name) end end end; table.sort(list); return list end; local function join(arr) return table.concat(arr, '|') end; local owned = getOwnedPickaxes(); getgenv().SelectedOwnedPickaxe = owned[1] or ''; local dropdown = Value:AddDropdown('OwnedPickaxeSelect', {Title = 'Owned Pickaxe', Values = (#owned > 0 and owned or {'None'}), Default = getgenv().SelectedOwnedPickaxe ~= '' and getgenv().SelectedOwnedPickaxe or 'None', Callback = function(V) getgenv().SelectedOwnedPickaxe = V end}); Value:AddButton({Title = 'Use Selected Pickaxe', Callback = function() local name = getgenv().SelectedOwnedPickaxe; if name and name ~= '' and name ~= 'None' and equipRemote then equipRemote:FireServer(name) end end}); task.spawn(function() local last = join(owned); while task.wait(1.5) do local current = getOwnedPickaxes(); local hash = join(current); if hash ~= last then last = hash; local values = (#current > 0 and current or {'None'}); if getgenv().SelectedOwnedPickaxe == '' or getgenv().SelectedOwnedPickaxe == 'None' or not table.find(current, getgenv().SelectedOwnedPickaxe) then getgenv().SelectedOwnedPickaxe = current[1] or 'None' end; if dropdown.Refresh then dropdown:Refresh(values) elseif dropdown.SetValues then dropdown:SetValues(values) end end end end)

getgenv().AutoBuyPickaxes = false; Value:AddToggle('AutoBuyPickaxes', {Title = 'Auto Buy Best Pickaxe', Default = false, Callback = function(V) getgenv().AutoBuyPickaxes = V; if V then task.spawn(function() local lp = game.Players.LocalPlayer; local remotes = game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage'):FindFirstChild('Remotes'); local buyRemote = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild('BuyPickaxeEvent'); local equipRemote = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild('EquipPickaxeEvent'); while getgenv().AutoBuyPickaxes do pcall(function() local cash = lp.leaderstats.Cash.Value; local gui = lp.PlayerGui:FindFirstChild('MainGui'); local frame = gui and gui:FindFirstChild('PickaxesFrame') and gui.PickaxesFrame:FindFirstChild('1'); if frame then local pickaxes = {}; local maxOwnedPrice = 0; for _, item in ipairs(frame:GetChildren()) do if item:IsA('ImageButton') and not item.Name:find('Temp') then local priceFrame = item:FindFirstChild('Frame') and item.Frame:FindFirstChild('ItemPrice'); local equipLabel = item:FindFirstChild('Frame') and item.Frame:FindFirstChild('Equip') and item.Frame.Equip:FindFirstChild('TextLabel'); if priceFrame and equipLabel then local priceText = priceFrame.Text:gsub('[%$,%.]', ''); local price = tonumber(priceText) or 0; local owned = (equipLabel.Text == 'Equip' or equipLabel.Text == 'Equipped'); if owned then maxOwnedPrice = math.max(maxOwnedPrice, price) end; table.insert(pickaxes, {Name = item.Name, Price = price, Owned = owned}) end end end; table.sort(pickaxes, function(a, b) return a.Price > b.Price end); for _, p in ipairs(pickaxes) do if not p.Owned and p.Price > maxOwnedPrice and cash >= p.Price then if buyRemote then buyRemote:FireServer(p.Name) end; if equipRemote then equipRemote:FireServer(p.Name) end; break end end end end); task.wait(1) end end) end end})
